questions.question: Convert to passive voice: 'The teacher explained the lesson.'
options: The lesson was explained by the teacher.
The lesson is explained by the teacher.
The lesson has been explained by the teacher.
The lesson will be explained by the teacher.
questions.correct_answer: The lesson was explained by the teacher.
questions.explanation: In passive voice, the object becomes the subject. Past tense 'explained' becomes 'was explained'.
